summary: Verified splash/brand image bug fix and new About modal in web app (via #ns=A URL to force child mode). All required functionality works. Splash image (naturalWidth=2000) and brand image (naturalWidth=2000) both load correctly. About modal opens, contains title/description/icon-guide (all 8 icons)/contact info/telegram+email links with correct hrefs, and closes via X, Escape and OK.

issues: Text 'اختصاصي مخطوطات' (specialist subtitle for designer) was not detected in modal innerText although 'د. محمد عمر أحمد الكاف' is shown. Likely rendered differently or truncated; visible label may be missing. Minor - verify.

action_items: Optional: verify presence of 'اختصاصي مخطوطات' subtitle under designer name in AboutModal contact section.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App runs inside iframe; navigate to <URL>/#ns=A directly to interact with ManuscriptRuler testids. Splash/brand images now use process.env.PUBLIC_URL||'.' fallback, resolving to same-origin absolute URLs in web (works) and relative in Electron.
rca of the issue: Root cause of original bug: absolute paths '/splash.png' and '/app-icon.png' fail in Electron file:// context. Fix: use `${process.env.PUBLIC_URL || '.'}/splash.png` so it becomes './splash.png' when PUBLIC_URL is empty. Confirmed working in web build (images load with naturalWidth 2000).
